name: 伏地兽
habitatEn: Caught from a 5-star Shiny Flower Seed
evolution: 伏地兽 → 贪食鼹 Lv.20 → 巨噬针鼹 Lv.32
description: 柔韧的吻部十分有弹性，没有牙齿，用舌头和吻部配合嘬取食物。每天吃几十只蚂蚁就可以存活，能量消耗很小，多数时间在睡觉。
descriptionEn: Its flexible snout is very elastic. It has no teeth and uses its tongue together with its snout to suck up food. Eating a few dozen ants a day is enough for it to survive; its energy consumption is very small, and it spends most of its time sleeping.

skills.name: 抓挠
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; restores 1 energy to itself.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 有效预防
skills.description: 减伤50%，应对攻击：下一次行动获得先手+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 50%; countering attacks: its next action gains priority +1.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the opponent switches spirits this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 乘胜追击
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，每次使用后，本技能连击数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; after each use, this skill's combo count is permanently +1.

skills.name: 摇篮曲
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+3，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains all skills energy cost +3; countering defense: additionally causes an interruption, and the enemy gains stun next turn.

skills.name: 吞噬
skills.description: 造成物伤，若使用本技能击败敌方，回复6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if this skill defeats the enemy, restores 6 energy.

skills.name: 连续爪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，应对状态：本次技能连击数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits; against Status: this skill's combo count is doubled.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; countering status: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

skills.name: 偷袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; countering status: this skill’s power becomes 3 times.
